concept: Review and integration: a personal relationship with ego, learning, and leadership
source_inspiration: original content — cumulative review, not sourced from any external text

exercise.reflection_prompt: Across accepting better ideas, asking for help, and leading without needing the spotlight — what's your personal throughline?
exercise.practice: Adult writes a short personal statement on what humility means to them in practice

assessment.success_marker: adult produces a personal statement referencing at least two of the three adult-stage scenarios
